brief:
Gaza's displaced population faces a deepening shelter crisis after recent floods destroyed approximately 70,000 tents, Drop Site News reported. The destruction compounds an already severe humanitarian emergency in the territory, where hundreds of thousands live in makeshift camps after mass displacement.

The flooding struck as winter conditions worsen across the region, threatening vulnerable populations already struggling with limited access to food, water, and medical services. Aid organizations have not yet announced plans to replace the destroyed shelters or provide alternative accommodation for the affected families.
title: Flooding destroys 70,000 tents across Gaza
